02 / The method

Ambition works better with a map.

Signal keeps a search honest without making it small. The fit model starts with what you can credibly do now, then creates room for the roles that ask you to grow.

01
Find the through-line

Group roles by the work underneath the title: designing complex systems, shaping AI experiences, or owning product direction.

02
Separate now from next

Strong-fit roles deserve the bulk of your time. Reach roles get a thoughtful application—not your whole week.

03
Make every tab actionable

Save the role, open the source listing, or hide it. A search should end in a decision, not another browser window.

Signal is a focused search layer for ambitious generalists. PUBLIC PREVIEW · DREAMWORK SNAPSHOT
